top_signals.title: Delevska: Need a Strong Leader to Run Nvidia
top_signals.summary: Nvidia boosted its sales forecast for next year and vowed to improve the company’s access to critical supplies while dismissing rumours of Jensen Huang’s return in their first earnings call since the scandal broke out. Ivana Delevska, CIO of Spear Invest spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the chip giant’s forecast. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Deutsche Bank hired a Qatari royal. Why?
top_signals.summary: Leaked documents reveal how dealings with royal dynasty blurred traditional boundaries between investor, client and counterparty
